correction_of_record.claim_corrected: validation truths realize Hill exponents 1 and 2 only, not 4; E1' possibly inapplicable
correction_of_record.reason: the corpus prefix token is pow2, which the canonicalizer rewrites to pow(X,2); exponent 4 is spelled pow2(pow2(x)) -> pow(pow(x,2),2), tokens pow,pow,x_i,2,2, and never produces a literal 4. A search for pow2 or pow,4 in the canonical skeleton therefore cannot detect it.
correction_of_record.new_mechanism_identified: multi-term components exceed max_unary_ops_per_dim=3 even at exponent 2 (U_mult>=6), and the affine rewrite B-R1 does NOT rescue them (affine expansion of a product of two Hill terms yields >=6 unaries). Preregistered as endpoint B-S4.

expected_direction_and_defect_protocol.defect_trigger: A-S3 < 0.0525 - 0.005 (the CAS cascade finds FEWER component matches than the crude neg folder)
protocol: halt reporting of Part A endpoints
recover from raw records the triples the crude folder matched and the cascade did not; store at phase1/matcher_regression_cases.json
diagnose (most likely cause: to_skeleton constant collapsing, or numeric_equivalent safe-domain rejection)

part_B.scope: 320 train + validation truths, per component, from the stored teacher_components_prefix
quantities: realized_hill_exponents (detected as NESTING DEPTH of pow2 over a variable-containing subtree: depth 1 -> exponent 2, depth 2 -> exponent 4)
U_mult (non-identity unary node count in the stored canonical multiplicative form)
U_affine (minimum over the preregistered rewrite set)
part_B.implementation_warning: a literal pow,4 token is NOT how exponent 4 is spelled in this corpus; an implementation searching for it is wrong by construction

rewrite_set.rule: A^n * inv(K + A^n) -> 1 - K * inv(K + A^n) for any subtree A, integer n >= 1
rewrite_set.name: activation to affine-decomposed repression

rewrite_set.rule: fold any pure-constant subtree to a single constant leaf
distribute mul over add ONLY when it strictly lowers the non-identity unary count

part_B.rewrite_verification: numeric_equivalent(n_points=32, seed=0); a failing rewrite is DISCARDED and logged as RewriteVerificationFailure
part_B.preregistered_limitation: U_affine is a minimum over a BOUNDED rewrite set, hence an UPPER bound on the true minimal unary count; an out_of_support claim is explicitly one-sided ('out of support under the preregistered rewrite set'), never 'out of support'
part_B.B_R1_does_not_rescue_multi_term: the affine expansion of a product of two Hill terms yields four terms with >= 6 unaries, so U_min for such components stays > 3
part_B.statistical_honesty: Part B per-system values are deterministic functions of a fixed corpus with no measurement noise; the Wilson interval describes sampling variability of the R01-R08 GENERATOR, not count uncertainty. Every artifact carries interval_interpretation: 'generator_sampling_not_measurement_error'
part_B.preregistered_possibility_of_inapplicabi: if B-S1 = 0, E1' is refuted for this corpus and that is itself a reportable result; calibration (P7: 25.0% of train systems exceed budget) makes an observed 0 unlikely and would additionally trigger a train/validation consistency check as a possible implementation defect

part_C.restriction: run ONLY on the in-support subset (systems all of whose components have U_min <= 3)
part_C.restriction_rationale: running Part C on out-of-support systems would conflate E1' with E2; the original proposal did not restrict it

build the embedder point bag exactly as src/gpu_run4/training.py:16 _point_bag; run embedder + encoder('fwd', causal=False) ONCE and cache src_enc for all sequences in the cell (compute saving AND fairness guarantee)
score with decoder('fwd', causal=True, src_enc=..., src_len=...) then decoder('predict', tensor=..., pred_mask=..., y=..., get_scores=True), gathering log-softmax at the pred_mask positions

sequences scored: GT-mult (stored tree_encoded), GT-affine (Part B rewrite re-encoded via env.equation_encoder.encode; failure -> AffineEncodingUnavailable), and each of the <=50 stored candidates re-encoded from candidate_formula_raw

reencoding_audit.rationale: no log-prob was ever stored (P9), so candidates must be re-encoded; this is the single largest threat to Part C
reencoding_audit.procedure: encode(parse(raw)) -> decode -> canonicalize, compare to the stored candidate_formula_canonical

length_normalization_policy.problem: GT sequences are long (P3: median 47, max 80 tokens) and candidates differ in length; unnormalized summed log-probability is monotonically penalized by length, which BIASES the diagnosis toward E2 (model error)
length_normalization_policy.handling: triple-reported quantity with a CONJUNCTIVE decision rule, not silent normalization

quantities.name: rank_pct_sum
quantities.definition: (# usable candidates with LOWER summed log-prob than GT-mult) / (# usable candidates); 0 = GT worse than every candidate the model sampled

quantities.name: rank_pct_length_matched
quantities.definition: same, on summed log-prob, restricted to candidates whose token length is within +/-20% of the GT token length; if fewer than 5 such candidates exist the cell is LengthMatchUnavailable and excluded from THIS SECONDARY ONLY, never from the primary

conjunctive_decision_rule.E2_model_error_supported_iff: C-S1, C-S2 and C-S3 upper 95% bounds all < 0.05, AND C-S4 >= 0.80 with Wilson lower bound > 0.70
conjunctive_decision_rule.E3_search_error_supported_iff: C-S1, C-S2 and C-S3 lower 95% bounds all >= 0.25, WHILE the Part A primary is approximately 0
conjunctive_decision_rule.on_disagreement: any disagreement among C-S1/C-S2/C-S3 in direction -> Part C verdict UNDECIDABLE, with the disagreement reported; this prevents choosing whichever normalization gives the tidier story

outcome_ladder.meaning: H-C0001-P SUPPORTED; GPU_RUN5's system-level claim survives
H-C0001-P UNSUPPORTED; prior claim requires partial revision; replication gate triggered

statistical_plan.power_limitation_stated_plainly: At n = 80 the 0.05 threshold in H-C0001-P is attainable ONLY by observing exactly zero hits: 1/80 already gives a Wilson upper bound of approximately 0.0675. The design cannot certify '<= 5%' in the presence of even one hit. This is why the ladder is graded rather than binary, and it means the primary is NOT a well-powered test of small positive rates; it is a test of whether the rate is essentially zero.

multiplicity.reporting_requirement: both adjusted and unadjusted intervals reported; every non-family artifact carries inference: 'descriptive' or 'exploratory'

frozen_wording_constraints: a Part A observation of 0/80 licenses ONLY 'the system-level semantic-equivalence-in-beam rate is bounded above by 0.046 with 95% confidence'. It does NOT license 'the rate is zero', 'the matcher makes no difference', 'M0 and M3 are equivalent', or 'the two matchers agree'

any Part C interval containing 0 licenses ONLY 'this design did not detect a difference of the preregistered size'. It does NOT license 'GT-affine and GT-mult are equally probable' or 'the GT is as likely as the sampled candidates'
a Part B rate of 0 licenses ONLY 'no validation system was out of support under the preregistered rewrite set'. It does NOT license 'the truth is in the generator's support'

any equivalence claim requires a preregistered equivalence margin and a two-one-sided-test procedure. NONE is preregistered in C0001. THEREFORE NO EQUIVALENCE CLAIM MAY BE MADE IN C0001 AT ALL. Stage 9 must enforce this.

failure_and_exclusion_policy.principle: nothing is silently dropped; every invalid, failed, timed-out or unparseable equation is written to the records with its failure_reason and counted in the denominator of its own diagnostic rate (rule 01 items 4 and 5)
failure_and_exclusion_policy.invalid_candidates: a candidate with valid == false is scored as a non-match with failure_reason preserved and is NEVER dropped from any denominator
failure_and_exclusion_policy.denominators: usable candidates present in the cell (47/48/49/50 per P10), never a hardcoded 50; the 13 missing candidates are recorded as candidate_return_shortfall

permitted_exclusions_all_counted_and_rep.exclusion: candidates failing the Part C re-encoding round trip

failure_and_exclusion_policy.numerical_fit_is_not_recovery: reconstruction_r2, generalization_r2 and NRMSE fields are carried as covariates and may be cross-tabulated against match status, but no match claim may be made from them (rule 01 item 6)

deviation_policy.general_rule: preserve original artifacts, append a dated DEVIATION-nn block, and either mark the affected endpoint exploratory or open a new preregistered cycle. Never edit frozen text; never change a threshold to rescue a result (rule 01 item 3)

named_contingencies.contingency: matcher times out on some fraction
named_contingencies.policy: < 2% of triples -> proceed, report as A-S7 (inside the N5 budget). 2-10% -> report the primary with timed-out triples counted as NON-matches (conservative against a spuriously large null) AND a clearly labeled sensitivity analysis counting them as matches; if the two disagree on the ladder rung the verdict is undecidable. > 10% -> undecidable. DO NOT raise SYMPY_OP_TIMEOUT_SEC (that would change the frozen instrument mid-cycle)

recover from phase3/cells/<cell_id>.json (which stores the full per-cell record including observations); if still absent the dependent endpoint is dropped, marked not_measurable_from_stored_artifacts, and reported as such. The PRIMARY depends only on candidate_formula_raw and teacher_components_infix, both verified present, so no field absence can void the primary

named_contingencies.contingency: the affine-decomposed encoding cannot be constructed automatically
named_contingencies.policy: per component log AffineEncodingUnavailable and fall back to GT-mult only. C-S5 is dropped if > 20% of in-support systems lack an affine encoding. Part B's U_affine falls back to U_mult for those components, making U_min = U_mult, the CONSERVATIVE direction (it over-reports out-of-support) and the report must say so. MANUAL hand-construction of affine encodings is FORBIDDEN: it would make the rewrite set unreproducible and investigator-dependent

preregistered reduced design chosen before running: stratified subsample of 4 of the 12 cells per system (bundle_index == 0, all 4 corruptions), giving 320 cells / ~16,000 candidates. The primary endpoint DEFINITION is unchanged; only the number of cells contributing to the ANY reduction shrinks. This WEAKENS the primary (fewer chances to find a hit), so a null under the reduced design must be reported with the reduced coverage stated explicitly
same reduced cell design (bundle_index == 0), then batch 1, then GPU 1
harness defect, not a finding. Halt, diagnose, and if unresolved the ENTIRE cycle is undecidable: no C0001 endpoint may be reported, because the comparator of record could not be reproduced

triggers: the Part A primary lands on the weak_positive or evaluator_artifact_confirmed rung (a revision or invalidation of a prior published campaign claim)
the independent reviewer marks any Part A result fragile
Part C returns an E2 or E3 verdict (a new mechanism claim on a single split and a single checkpoint)

minimum_design_factors_changed.replication: seed = 1 and an independent safe-domain point set
fresh process, clean checkout at a recorded commit, independent run ID results/runs/gpu_runclaude1_c0001r_<short7>/
executed by lansr-replication-specialist, distinct from implementer and primary analyst

replication_gate.built_in_corpus_positive_control: the frozen string matcher already reports 4/252 = 1.59% [0.0062, 0.0401] truth-in-beam on ODEBench (C-ODEB), so the cascade must reproduce a non-zero baseline and must return M3 >= M0 there. A cascade returning 0 on ODEBench is broken, independently of anything it says about GRN

layer_analysis_contract.layer_adjacent_item: A-S8 is a STATEMENT of a testable consequence for a later cycle, not a measurement; C0001 does not test it and must not imply that it has

must_confirm: the four explanations are mutually discriminating as operationalized
Part C's restriction to the in-support subset is correct
the ANY vs MEAN reductions answer the stated questions
Wilson vs Student-t choices and dof
test isolation and the firewall (grep for sealed)
that teacher_forcing_loss is EXTENDED, not modified

required_reviews_before_full_experiment.special_instruction: check specifically that no artifact, table, figure or sentence presents the component-level rate (A-S3) as a discovery, and raise any such framing as MAJOR

literature_constraints_honored.constraint: ODEFormer (ICLR 2024) declines to measure symbolic recovery and reports only R2 > 0.9
literature_constraints_honored.honored_by: C0001 endpoints are structural match rates, unary counts and log-probabilities; trajectory fit is a covariate only

literature_constraints_honored.constraint: ODEFormer Appendix G: increasing beam size improves reconstruction but not generalization; CTC_NSR: beam 150 provided no additional information
literature_constraints_honored.honored_by: no beam or temperature sweep is preregistered as any endpoint

literature_constraints_honored.constraint: teacher-forced GT scoring is adjacent, precedented by Stahlberg & Byrne EMNLP-IJCNLP 2019 pp.3356-3362, DOI 10.18653/v1/D19-1331, https://aclanthology.org/D19-1331/
literature_constraints_honored.honored_by: cited as adjacent; no novelty claim for the instrument

literature_constraints_honored.constraint: no biological-causality language on synthetic Hill-type data
any exact/skeleton-recovery metric must state which algebraic form counts as a match and report both literal and canonical scoring
literature_constraints_honored.honored_by: the M0-M3 cascade reports all four levels separately

literature_constraints_honored.constraint: any generation-side intervention must report the support-budget count for its target skeletons
the ODEBench variable-denominator arity question is worth folding in cheaply

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: REFUTED coordinator Finding 2: exponent 4 IS realized in this corpus (39/170 validation, 130/510 train components), spelled pow2(pow2(x)) -> pow(pow(x,2),2), never as a literal pow,4 token
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: the search that produced Finding 2 looked for pow2 or pow,4 in the CANONICAL skeleton, where pow2 is rewritten to pow(X,2); E1' is LIVE, not inapplicable

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: identified a SECOND, previously unnamed E1' mechanism: multi-term components exceed the per-dimension unary budget even at exponent 2 (U_mult >= 6), and the affine rewrite does NOT rescue them
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: the original brief attributed E1' solely to multiplicative Hill-4; train inspection shows counts of 5, 6 and 10, and R07's product-of-two-Hill-2 form is not rescuable. Preregistered as B-S4

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: restricted Part C to the Part B in-support subset, with an n >= 30 power floor
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: the original proposal ran Part C on all 80 systems, which conflates E1' with E2; scoring an out-of-support truth's log-probability cannot distinguish 'the model gives it no mass' from 'the generator never sampled that form'

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: added negative/specificity controls PC3a (wrong exponent) and PC3b (permuted variable)
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: the brief required only positive controls; a null-shaped primary is equally destroyed by an OVER-permissive matcher, and only a specificity control detects that

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: made Part C's length handling a CONJUNCTIVE triple-report (summed, per-token, length-matched) with mandatory agreement, rather than choosing one normalization
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: GT sequences are longer than candidates (P3), so unnormalized log-prob is biased toward the E2 verdict; a single normalization would let the analyst pick the tidier story

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: added the mandatory re-encoding round-trip audit with 10%/10% tolerances and an undecidable verdict
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: Stage-3 inspection established that NO log-probability was ever stored (P9), so all candidate scores must be recomputed from re-encoded strings; without the audit, Part C could silently compare the GT against sequences the model never actually emitted

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: made the primary system-level and the component-level ESTIMATION-ONLY, with the disclosed 5.25% repurposed as null-credibility condition N6 (a sanity floor)
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: coordinator constraint (b): the component-level figure has been seen, so it cannot be a blind discovery test; using it as a floor extracts value from it without claiming it

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: replaced the single 0.05 null threshold with a graded three-rung outcome ladder and stated the n = 80 power limitation plainly
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: at n = 80 a Wilson upper bound < 0.05 is attainable ONLY at exactly zero hits (1/80 gives 0.0675); a binary threshold would have forced threshold-shopping at 1-3 hits

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: flagged the M3-vs-M0 paired Student-t as an INVALID test and replaced it with a Wilson interval on the M3 indicator
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: M0 == 0 for all 80 systems, so the paired difference is degenerate Bernoulli, not continuous; the brief asked for paired Student-t on differences generally

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: added Gate B->C condition that Part C is NOT RUN if Part A lands on evaluator_artifact_confirmed
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: if E0 is confirmed the premise of the model-vs-search question has changed; the correct next move is replication of Part A, not diagnosis of a failure that may not exist

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: specified that the new summed-log-prob function must be ADDED alongside teacher_forcing_loss, never modify it, with a regression test asserting sum/n == -mean_CE
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: other GPU_RUN5 phases depend on the audited mean-CE function; modifying it would silently change prior code paths

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: added Part D as EXPLORATORY only, with an explicit prohibition on citing it as a C0001 finding
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: the brief offered it as a secondary endpoint 'if cheap'; it is on a different corpus (ODEBench) with no preregistered hypothesis, so it cannot carry inference

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: added the matcher-defect protocol with a preregistered expected direction (A-S3 >= 0.0525)
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: coordinator constraint (c): an unexpectedly LOWER CAS number than the crude token folder must be flagged as a defect, not reported as a result

changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.change: recorded that no train candidate set exists (all 47,987 stored candidates are validation), so the matcher cannot be timing-calibrated on train candidates; calibration uses ODEBench instead
changes_made_to_the_coordinator_proposal.reason: an honest statement of a design limitation, found at Stage 3 rather than discovered mid-run
